newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends steady at 14.88 a kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends steady at 14.88 a kg.

text.p: Tin price ended steady at Monday's 14.88 ringgit ($5.95) a kg after both buyers and sellers decided to close deals at the opening level.

"The market held steady despite falls in London," a trader said, adding that there were some European and local buying supporting at lower levels. Turnover was 93 tonnes against 79 on Monday. The local price differential over London was $80 a tonne premium against $15 previously. Traders expect the market to drift steadily at around current levels and could rise back to 15.00 ringgit if demand continues active.
